Step 1: Start date: 1703-02 (February 1703).  
Step 2: Add 40 years → 1743-02.  
Step 3: Add 6 months → 1743-08 (August 1743).  
Step 4: Check for leap year or day-of-month overflow: February to August doesn’t cross a month-end with invalid day, so date remains 1743-08-01 (assuming 1st day of month).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1743-08-01
